spans.s:
प्रैष, अस्, m. an invitation, order, command
(especially in liturgical language, = प्रेष); sending,
directing; sorrow, distress, affliction; phrenzy, in-
toxication, insanity (?).
—प्रैष-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved.
executing orders or commands, a servant.

प्रैषणिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रेषण), executing
orders or commissions (as a means of livelihood),
fitted for the execution of commands.

प्रैषम्, ind., Ved. in the formula प्रैषैः
or इष्टिभिः प्रैषम् इच्छति, he strives to start
(the sacrifice compared to an animal in the chase)
with invocations or exclamations.

प्रैषिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रैष), belonging
to or connected with the invitatory formulas (in
liturgical language).

प्रैष्य, अस्, m. a servant, slave; (आ), f. a female
servant; (अम्), n. the being a servant, servitude.
—प्रैष्य-भाव, अस्, m. the state or condition
of a servant, servitude.

प्रैकीय प्रैकीय (fr. प्र + एक), Nom. P.
प्रैकीयति, -यितुम्, = प्रेकीय, see Vopa-deva

प्रैय प्रैय, अम्, n. an abstract noun from
प्रिय, see Gaṇa Pṛthv-ādi to Pāṇ.
प्रैयक, अस्, m. a patronymic from Priyaka.

प्रैयङ्गव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रियङ्गु), Ved.
relating to panic-grass.

प्रैय्यङ्गव, a wrong form for प्रैयङ्गव,
q. v.

प्रैयमेध, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. an adj. from
प्रिय-मेध; (अस्), m., N. of a Sāman; a patro-
nymic of Sindhu-kṣit.

प्रैय्यमेध, अस्, m. a patronymic; (अस्, ई,
अम्), a wrong form for प्रैयमेध, q. v.

प्रैयरूपक, अम्, n. an abstract noun from
प्रिय-रूप.

प्रैयव्रत, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to
Priya-vrata; (अस्), m. a patronymic from Priya-vrata.
